name: 047_tv_wavetrend
hypothesis: TradingView port (PLAN.md section 13), 'WaveTrend Oscillator [LazyBear]'. The indicator's idea: a smoothed channel index of hlc3; when its fast line crosses its slow line inside the overbought/oversold zone, the stretch is exhausted and price turns. Author defaults kept: channel length 10, average length 21, signal SMA 4, level 2 = 53. It is an indicator, so an entry rule had to be chosen: long when wt1 crosses above wt2 below -53, short when it crosses below wt2 above +53 (the published zone lines). DEVIATIONS the engine forces: the TradingView version stays in the market and only reverses on the opposite signal; the engine has no stop-and-reverse and every trade must risk 1%, so a pct stop and a time stop are added and are the only grid keys. TradingView's default commission is 0; here it is 0.05% taker + 0.02% slippage + funding. Source chart 4h; variants in chart mode (the same bar counts on every chart).
